verdict.rationale: Omarchy is built on Arch Linux and uses standard Arch package mirrors, and documentation confirms dual-boot support alongside Windows/other OSes on a single partition, plus full-disk encryption and firewall defaults suggesting standard hardware compatibility rather than vendor lock-in. Community reports corroborate real-world installs on laptops and various hardware (including dual-boot on a work laptop), but there's no explicit hardware compatibility list, and some community notes point to opinionated defaults (silent repo additions, single-user design) that could constrain flexibility. Missing for 10: explicit hardware compatibility documentation, evidence of running on non-x86 or diverse hardware configs, and independent confirmation that no proprietary lock-in exists beyond Arch base.
